ItemID: NA; Title: Fire TV Stick streaming device with Alexa built in, includes Alexa Voice Remote, HD, latest release; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I already have a 4K Fire TV Stick and a Fire TV television, so another HD streaming device adds little.

ItemID: NA; Title: Echo Show 5 (1st Gen, 2019 release) -- Smart display with Alexa – stay connected with video calling - Charcoal; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: A smart display appeals to me, but I prefer the larger Show 8 and do not need both.
